faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about Bolão.io: what a bolão is, how to create a free soccer betting pool with friends, how scoring works and which competitions are covered.
faq.a1: A bolão is a Brazilian-style prediction pool where friends bet on the results of soccer matches — no bookmakers and no money required. It is hugely popular in Brazil during the World Cup and major championships. On Bolão.io, you predict the score of each match and earn points based on how close you get.
faq.q2: How do I create a free bolão online?
faq.a2: Create a free account at bolao.io, click "Create bolão", give it a name and pick a competition. You get an invite link to share with friends, and the whole process takes less than a minute.
faq.a3: Yes, 100% free. There are no subscriptions, no hidden costs and no real-money betting. The app never handles money — it only tracks predictions and points. Many groups agree on a prize among themselves, but that happens outside the app.
faq.q4: How do friends join my bolão?
faq.a4: Share your bolão's invite link. Friends open it, create a free account (or sign in) and are automatically added to your bolão, ready to make their predictions.

scoring.intro: You earn points for each match prediction. The highest matching rule applies:
scoring.tierExact: 200 pts — Exact score (e.g. result 3-0, your bet 3-0)
scoring.tierWinnerScore: 150 pts — Winner's goals correct (e.g. result 3-0, your bet 3-1)
scoring.tierDraw: 150 pts — Draw predicted, not exact (e.g. result 1-1, your bet 0-0)
scoring.tierWinnerLoser: 120 pts — Winner and loser's goals (e.g. result 3-1, your bet 2-1)
scoring.tierGoalDiff: 100 pts — Winner and goal difference (e.g. result 2-1, your bet 1-0)
scoring.tierWinnerOnly: 80 pts — Winner only (e.g. result 1-0, your bet 3-2)
scoring.championBonus: Pick the championship winner for a one-time +500 pt bonus added to your leaderboard total.
scoring.outro: The leaderboard updates automatically as results come in.

faq.a6: Bolão.io covers major competitions such as the World Cup, Brasileirão Série A and B, Copa do Brasil, Copa America, Libertadores, UEFA Champions League, Premier League, La Liga and Ligue 1, with fixtures and results updated automatically.

about.title: About
about.metaDescription: The story behind Bolão.io: a free web app for creating soccer betting pools (bolões) with friends, built in Brazil, covering the World Cup, Brasileirão and more.
about.bolaoDesc1: In Brazil, a bolão is a betting pool between friends usually around soccer championships. It is very popular during the World Cup and other major tournaments. For the pronunciation check this
about.bolaoDesc2: We started around 2016 doing them on a piece of paper and I decided to try a digital solution. It does not involve money even if most friends like to agree on a prize for the winner. But that's something the app does not deal with.
about.bolaoDesc3: After much research of existing solutions, I came to the reality that none of them was what I expected in terms of UX, design and functionality. That's when I started writing code, around 2017. The app has been growing ever since, fixing mistakes, going through massive updates and design changes. This very version you are on is the major 3, or the third big iteration of the application.
about.whoDesc: This is a one person project. My name is Kevin and I'm a software developer and former web designer living in Rio de Janeiro - Brazil. If you really want to know more about me, head to
about.techDesc1: As stated before, this is a web app, which means no Android or iOS extra app to download. Just open your browser at https://bolao.io. This allows me to constantly roll out changes without the users having to update their native apps.
about.techDesc2: The app is built with NextJS, Typescript and React, hosted at Vercel and uses Postgres for the database. It uses Prismic.io for the headless CMS and Clerk for the auth management.
about.coverageDesc: The app uses the API of <apiLink>api-football.com</apiLink> to get the latest fixtures and results. For now just a handful of leagues are available, but upon request more could be added. Feel free to reach me at <linkedinLink>LinkedIn</linkedinLink>.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.metaDescription: How Bolão.io handles personal data, cookies and similar technologies.
privacy.intro: This notice explains how Bolão.io handles personal data when you use our website and services. It is intended to provide the clear information required by applicable privacy law, including Brazil's LGPD.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: Bolão.io is the controller of the personal data described in this notice. Use our contact form for privacy questions, requests, or concerns.

data.title: Data we handle
data.body: We only handle data needed to run and improve the service.
data.account: Account data provided through Clerk, such as your name, username, email address and authentication identifiers.
data.activity: Bolão activity, including bolão names, memberships, predictions, points and leaderboard display information.
data.contact: Contact-form information, including the email address and message you send us.
data.technical: Technical and usage information, such as browser, device, pages viewed and performance information.

purposes.title: Why we use data
purposes.body: We use personal data to create and secure accounts, operate bolões and predictions, show standings, provide support, prevent abuse, maintain and improve the service, and understand aggregate site use. The applicable legal basis depends on the purpose, including performance of the service, legal obligations, legitimate interests such as security and reliability, or consent where required.

sharing.title: Service providers and data sharing
sharing.body: We use service providers to operate Bolão.io. They process data on our instructions or under their own applicable privacy terms. Depending on your use, data may be processed outside Brazil.
sharing.clerk: Clerk provides account authentication and session management.
sharing.vercel: Vercel provides hosting, web analytics and performance insights.
sharing.infrastructure: Vercel Postgres stores application data such as bolões, memberships and predictions.
sharing.content: Prismic provides content-management services for site content.
sharing.email: Resend sends messages submitted through the contact form.
sharing.football: API-Football provides fixture and result data; we do not send it your account data to retrieve public football information.

cookies.title: Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.body: Bolão.io uses cookies and browser storage for the purposes below. You can manage or clear cookies in your browser, but doing so may affect sign-in or preferences.
cookies.locale: A NEXT_LOCALE cookie remembers your selected language for up to one year.
cookies.auth: Clerk uses authentication-related cookies or similar technologies to keep your account session secure.
cookies.storage: Temporary session storage may keep an invite or selected competition while you continue a sign-in or creation flow.
cookies.analytics: Vercel Analytics, Vercel Speed Insights and Umami help us understand performance and aggregate use. Their behavior may vary with their configuration and your browser settings.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.body: We keep data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described here, including maintaining your account and bolão history, resolving disputes, meeting legal obligations and protecting the service. We may retain anonymized or aggregated information longer.

rights.title: Your privacy rights
rights.body: Subject to applicable law, you may request confirmation and access to your data, correction, anonymization, blocking or deletion where appropriate, information about sharing, portability, revocation of consent, and review of certain automated decisions. Contact us to make a request. You may also complain to the Brazilian data-protection authority (ANPD).

security.title: Security
security.body: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures intended to protect personal data. No internet service can guarantee absolute security, so please keep your account credentials confidential.

updates.title: Changes to this notice
updates.body: We may update this notice when our practices or legal requirements change. We will post the updated version here and change the date above.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.metaDescription: Terms for using Bolão.io, the free social football prediction app.
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of Bolão.io. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these terms and our Privacy Notice.

service.title: The service
service.body: Bolão.io is a free social football prediction service. It lets friends create groups, predict match scores and compare points. Bolão.io does not accept, process or pay out money, and it is not a bookmaker, gambling operator or financial service.

accounts.title: Accounts and invitations
accounts.body: You are responsible for the information associated with your account and for keeping access to it secure. Invite links are intended for people you choose to invite; do not use them to harass others or distribute them in a way that creates unwanted access or disruption.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: Use Bolão.io lawfully and respectfully. Do not interfere with the service, attempt unauthorized access, use automated means that harm the service, impersonate others, submit unlawful or abusive content, or use the app to organize or promote illegal gambling.

content.title: Your content and group activity
content.body: You remain responsible for bolão names and other content you submit. We may remove content or restrict access when reasonably necessary to protect users, comply with law, or keep the service reliable and safe.

availability.title: Availability and changes
availability.body: We work to keep Bolão.io available and accurate, but match data, scores, features and availability may change or be interrupted. We may modify, suspend or discontinue features when necessary. Do not rely on the service for financial, betting or other high-stakes decisions.

thirdParties.title: Third-party services
thirdParties.body: Bolão.io relies on third parties for services such as authentication, hosting, football data and content. Their services and any external links are governed by their own terms and privacy policies.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms as the service evolves or legal requirements change. We will post the new version here and update the date above. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about these terms or the service, please use the contact page.
